method: Research priority = rounded sum of factor weight × value/5 × evidence multiplier (V0 0, V1 .35, V2 .65, V3 .85, V4 1). Unknown earns zero. The next-test factor is an analyst judgment. This is not a probability, valuation, power score or spending authorization. Priority tier additionally requires current sourced polygon and all nine core county checks at full-polygon scope. Shared assemblage files are not independent opportunities. Prior rejections are strategy-specific and may be reopened with new evidence.

sections.title: Land and buildable-area test
sections.body: Do not choose the largest acreage number or subtract an assumed road strip from marketing acreage. First establish the deed parcel and offered portion.
